exceptions.rationale: Phase 5D full-universe gap analysis (active-span aware, approved NYSE calendar) found WBD missing exactly two internal daily sessions, 2022-04-06 and 2022-04-07, inside the Discovery/WarnerMedia merger transition window (WBD regular-way trading began 2022-04-11 after a when-issued period). Alpaca SIP holds thin-volume data for both dates (63,434 and 272,978 shares), proving the market was open; Tiingo's consolidated series omits them. Tiingo-side provider gap, not a calendar or methodology artifact.
exceptions.residual_impact_statement: Neither date is a month-end rebalance signal date nor a next-open execution date. The Phase 5D full production backtest ran directly against this exact Tiingo data (gap included): zero of the 5 observed rebalance-selection differences involve WBD on or near these dates, and trade count delta vs SIP was -1 overall. affected_rebalance_decision_count = 0. Reported honestly, not softened: the gap is real but empirically immaterial to ranking decisions.
